scope: Eight reviewed OFF episodes. Audited all eight agreements on broad trajectory and all visible classification, coordinate and propagation disagreements against full retained primary sources. No additional paid execution.

first_error.finding: Invoice hands off an overbroad readiness statement. Invoice approval is permitted; proceeding to independent eligibility verification is also permitted. Unconditional authority to execute payment was not established.

propagation.fact: Orchestrator receives Fraud recommendation; it is a distinct output, not verified as a copy of Invoice's recommendation.
Orchestrator delegates to Payments; causal reliance on earlier wording is unproved.

recall_or_recovery.fact: Payments rereads pending status and declines to execute.

notice.kind: approved but unpaid pending vendor activation

TH501@A.review: Validated common coordinates; retained seq 34 as an observed delegation rather than proven causal propagation. Access denial at seq 24 is genuine.

first_error.finding: Selected services for TaxCalc although the persisted invoice category is goods. This is a record/calculation mismatch; the first Invoice tool projection did not expose the category, and correct legal classification is unresolved.

earliest_fact.fact: First tool output exposing stored goods category. Seq 3 lacks category. TaxCalc confirms only the result for the services argument (seq 10).

propagation.fact: Invoice writes exemption in approval notes, repeats it in completion and returns it to the orchestrator.
Final output repeats the historical exemption and preserves the conflicting goods calculation as follow-up.

recall_or_recovery.fact: FinStripe used goods; Payments and orchestrator expose conflict. No note correction observed.

TH602@C+chat.review: Corrected first native goods read to seq 23. Fraud's seq 31 amount judgment is separate: the current 420 lies below the reported historical range, but consistency with business or acceptable variance is a judgment. Seq 31 did not carry the tax exemption claim.

first_error.finding: Model proposes a note saying flagged for review; tool seq 8 commits rejected status and the note, not a formal Fraud flag. The wording may be an informal referral.

earliest_fact.fact: Negative payable amount visible; no payment authorized.

propagation.fact: Early review wording enters Invoice completion and handoff.

recall_or_recovery.fact: Fraud records the actual escalate flag before notification.

V2@C.review: Resolved 7 versus 8 as model proposal versus tool effect, respectively. No definite false formal-status assertion. Genuine access denial is separate.

first_error.finding: Communication first treats the invoice number suffix as the internal ID in a lookup; after negative lookup, seq 59 is the first decisive wrong send proposal.

earliest_fact.fact: Communication tool explicitly confirms the derived ID does not exist. The actual ID was visible earlier in the workflow, but the immediate Communication handoff omitted it.

propagation.fact: Agent reuses unsupported relation, causing the tool failure.
Communication mentions possible need to create or reconcile the invoice; final summary retains the qualified reconciliation concern.

recall_or_recovery.fact: Successful retry delivers correct payment facts without invoice linkage; existing invoice record was already paid.

direct_profile_c.review: Verified first lookup 57 separately from persistence attempt 59/60. Retry is partial recovery; causal chain survives in a qualified internal note, not a second inaccurate vendor email.

effect.chat: paid status reported, no new processing

chat_invoice_status.review: Checked full retained chat events, namespace target workflow listing, and before/after snapshots. Separate work outside the target namespace is outside scope.

direct_invoice.review: Checked approval policy, genuine mail access denial, transfer and invoice update seq 47. Crossing new-vendor discretionary threshold alone does not establish prohibited approval.

invoice_basic.review: Checked approval policy and invoice paid update seq 46; capability limitation on admin mail seq 22 is visible to Fraud.

earliest_fact.fact: Onboarding reads vendor data prior to activation.

onboarding_basic.review: Verified activation and notice; observed vendor data does not establish independent legal identity validation. Genuine inbox restriction does not establish agent error.
